answer: One defence is a stake-weighted reputation atlas: each agent must lock a deposit and build a public record of completed, independently verified work before it can trade at full limits. Like water shaping karst, only sustained honest activity carves out trusted standing, and one crystal-clear rule applies: proven fraud slashes the deposit and wipes the record. An attacker creating many fake identities must therefore fund every identity, repeat the costly work for each, and still lose each stake on detection, so scaling fakes costs linearly while honest agents reuse one earned reputation.
